history.origins: Vändåtta ("turn eight") is the Swedish version of Crazy Eights, from the Eights group of matching games. It is widely played in Sweden and is commonly played for points over multiple deals, with penalty scoring for cards left in hand. Rules information was contributed by Carl Svensson (casinointernet.se).
timeline: 20th century: Swedish variant of Crazy Eights documented and widely played.
history.evolution: Sweden's most popular casual card game.

setup.deck: Standard 52-card pack; two decks shuffled together if more than five players.
setup.dealing: 7 each. Rest = draw pile. Top card starts play pile.

rules.objective: Be the first to shed all cards. When played for points, lowest penalty total after an agreed number of deals wins.
rules.gameplay: Match suit or rank. 8=wild (choose suit). A=all draw 1, then play same suit. Can play multiple same-rank cards. Draw up to 3 if can't play. Say 'Lappen!' at 1 card or draw 3. Can't end on 8 or A.

variations.name: Same suit for multiple cards
variations.description: When playing several cards at once the first must match the top discard by suit (not rank).
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variation changes play rule only; no engine constant overrides.

variations.name: No Ace on Ace
variations.description: After an Ace the next card must be an ordinary card of the same suit; Ace may not be played on Ace.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variation changes Ace follow rule only; no engine overrides.

variations.name: Lappen only for one card
variations.description: Lappen call required only when you have one ordinary card; if your last cards are several of the same rank you may go out without warning.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variation changes Lappen call condition only; no engine overrides.

scoring.description: 8=10-50pts, A=5-15pts, Face=10pts, Others=face value. Lowest total wins over rounds.
